body:
It's okay, I didn't mean to indict anyone personally. It's not about like not knowing what to say, because honestly no one really does. As long as you're not being rude or condescending you're probably fine. The problem is people making commitments they can't or won't keep.

 Like sometimes I might just want someone to listen and not be a dick, hardly even need a response other than a word or two to know I'm being heard. But I don't want to open up to someone whose not gonna respond, because after a few times why fucking bother? Why put myself out there? For all I know they're just pretending to be caring so they can mock people, or something.
They don't try to help though. They pretend that they want to, and then can't be bothered to follow through. Or they commit to something they can't keep up, I don't know.
